## Objective
- Update the existing dinosaur, dragon, and kaiju card game into a Spanish-language, turn-based deck battler with 30-card decks, elemental monster types, attack, health, monster effects, and support cards.

## Requirements
- “Juego por turnos en donde sean decks de 30 cartas divide a todos los monstruos en elementos con ataque de poder y vida, efectos en cada moustro y cartas ayuda”
- Keep all user-facing game text in Spanish.

## Decisions
- The game already has three habitats and a CPU rival; retain these unless a gameplay change is needed for the requested deck-battler mechanics.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` has `lang="es"` and several static interface labels and monster names/descriptions translated into Spanish.
- Added Spanish UI placeholders for player/rival life and deck counts; changed the displayed round label to 15 turns.

### Active
- Implement actual 30-card decks, turn-based play, monster elements, attack and health stats, monster effects, and support cards.
- Complete Spanish translation of remaining dynamic/user-facing strings.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `index.html` game data and logic so both sides use 30-card decks and play through 15 turns.
2. Implement elements, attack/health combat, monster effects, support cards, and UI for life/deck counts.
3. Translate remaining interface, status, result, accessibility, and dynamically rendered text into Spanish.
4. Test a complete game and verify the deck, combat, and turn systems work.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the game UI, card pool, state, rendering, and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing code still implements five turns, sums creature `power` for habitat control, and has no 30-card decks or health/combat system. The card pool currently has 15 monsters.
- Recent edits only changed static markup/placeholders; corresponding JavaScript behavior and dynamic labels have not yet been updated.

- Setup flow: let the player choose among 3 decks, then choose their rival, then decide who goes first, and start combat.

- The game uses 15 rounds, 30 life per player, and one card action per turn.

### Active

- Connect the setup flow to the existing `newGame()`/game state so combat does not begin before setup is complete.
- Check all remaining user-facing strings for Spanish and test the complete game flow.

- (none)

1. Inspect `index.html` setup markup and game initialization.
2. Implement the deck selection, rival selection, and first-player setup screens/actions.
3. Start the battle only after all choices are made; adapt CPU behavior for the selected rival/deck and first-player choice.
4. Test setup, turns, combat, and game completion; run syntax and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the game UI, card pool, deck/combat logic, and newly added setup-modal markup.

## Objective
- Convert the existing game into a Spanish turn-based card battler with setup, five beast spaces per side, and a separate power-card space.
- Finish reviewing the responsive layout and validate the full game flow.

## Requirements
- Keep all player-facing game text in Spanish.
- Preserve three themed decks/rivals, 15 rounds, 30 life per player, and one card action per turn.
- Setup flow: choose a deck, choose a rival, decide who goes first, then battle.
- Beast cards have elements, attack, health, and effects; power effects last one turn.

## Decisions
- Keep the existing three habitats and CPU rival.
- Build each deck from a pool of 30 distinct cards: 20 beasts and 10 powers.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` implements the card pool, five board slots per side, power slots, setup flow, and combat logic.
- CPU play now filters cards and chooses only valid target lanes.
- Updated setup, footer, and help text for five spaces and distinct cards.

3. Rerun syntax, logic, and diff checks; inspect the final mobile layout.

- `index.html`: Game UI, styles, setup, card pool, and battle logic.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-feral.cjs`: Passing Node VM logic checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/browser-feral.cjs`: Browser flow checks; currently fails at battle rendering.
- `/tmp/opencode/feral-mobile.png`: Chromium mobile screenshot from the initial rendering state.

- Browser exception: `Cannot set properties of null (setting 'innerHTML')` in `render()` when accessing `#energyPips`.
